beats.event: Dorothy lives with Aunt Em, Uncle Henry, and Toto in Kansas
Cyclone sweeps house and Dorothy into the Land of Oz
House kills Wicked Witch of the East; Munchkins celebrate
Good Witch of the North gives her the silver shoes
Dorothy rescues the Scarecrow from his pole
Oils the rusted Tin Woodman, who joins her quest
Meets the Cowardly Lion, who joins the group
Party reaches the Emerald City; audience with the Wizard
Wizard demands they kill the Wicked Witch of the West
Companions repel wolves, crows, and bees sent by the witch
Winged Monkeys capture Dorothy; the witch enslaves her
Dorothy melts the witch with a bucket of water
Wins the Golden Cap; frees companions; returns to Emerald City
Wizard exposed as an ordinary man; gives symbolic gifts
Wizard's balloon lifts off without her; she is stranded
Glinda reveals her silver shoes can carry her home
Dorothy clicks her heels three times; wakes safe in Kansas
